summary: Bug fix verification tests for PDPV ticket system: 1) ACEITE_LINK status display, 2) False error toast on quote link generation, 3) Auto status change on ticket assignment. All 3 bug fixes verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used provided test tickets: 45f94275-0164-40db-b3cc-6c658bf0cd70 (ACEITE_LINK) and 222daadb-f066-4098-b759-cd78d5a81073 (EM_TRATAMENTO). Created additional test tickets during test execution for status change verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bug fixes verified working: 1) ACEITE_LINK status now displays as a Badge (data-testid='status-badge-auto') instead of broken Select dropdown, 2) Quote link generation no longer shows false error toast (clipboard errors handled separately), 3) Status auto-changes from ABERTO to EM_TRATAMENTO when assigned_to_user_id is set via PUT /api/tickets/{id}.
